name: test-e2e
description: Use this skill when writing, reviewing, or planning end-to-end and browser-based component tests with Playwright or Cypress. It guides agents through user-focused browser automation, interaction coverage, test structure, selector strategy, and CI setup. For isolated logic or rendering checks that do not need a browser, use the test-unit skill instead.
when: When writing end-to-end tests with Playwright
do-not-use-when: Testing isolated logic or component rendering that doesn't need a browser — use test-unit instead
